subs.text: Kim — this is your athletic brand: your name, your photos, your voice. Already a working platform.
A private preview — only you have this link. Nothing here is published or indexed.
A home for the Après London brand — coaching, race tools and the commercial engine behind them.
Your coaching, structured like a season — the athletic profile your results deserve.
Your story and race imagery give the platform its personality. A brand, not a template.
Free tools give people a reason to visit your brand. Coaching has a clear next step when they're ready.
Events and race planning sit alongside the coaching — one roof for the whole operation.
The community wall — race-day photos in your colours. The demo entries show the layout.
Ask Kim — questions reach you properly, under your brand, not buried in DMs.
Your coaching page sells the offer like a brand — clear packages, hybrid coaching offers and a real application route.
Find a race-mate — doubles, mixed and relay partners, inside your brand's home.
A community feature that runs itself between race weekends.
The predictor lets athletes explore a target finish — inside your platform.
Tools like this make your brand part of their training week.
The split analyser turns a finish time into station-by-station insight.
Results — a living record of race performances, wearing your name.
Stations Prep — every HYROX station, coached in your voice, shot in your colours.
Coaching value before anyone has paid you — that's brand-building.
Run Zone — pacing and race-day running guidance under your name.
Taper Zone — the final week, structured so athletes actually do it. Your brand in their race week.
Calendar & Travel — race dates with official links, kept current without you lifting a finger.
Race Crew — your community organised on your own platform, home and abroad.
HYROX news under the Après London name — fresh content keeps the brand alive between races.
Your partners and offers presented like a professional outfit — brand deals, not a link dump.
Join the list — every visitor becomes a contact your brand owns, not an audience you rent.
And the part that lets you take control of the business — the Desk. First, Leads.
Every enquiry lands here — ask forms, session requests, partner interest — enquiry to reply.
Attention on the public site becomes conversations, then clients. That's control.
Campaigns — scale with social media campaigns, deployed at the tap of a button.
Pick a photo, set when to advertise — a race weekend, a location, an audience.
The platform drafts the post and story — set a spend cap, approve, and you're scaling.
Client results become campaigns too — with their sign-off built in.
And Finance — the money side of the brand, under your control.
Coaching income, race costs and partner activity — one dashboard.
Know what comes in, see what goes out — the whole business in one place.
Your coaching, your tools, your community — one brand, one roof.
Have a look around, Kim. I'd love to hear what you think.
